name: DBAPPSecurity Mingjian Vulnerability Scanner Connector
description: Read-only connector package for DBAPPSecurity Mingjian Vulnerability Scanner. It syncs scanned assets and vulnerability findings through the device tool registry.

release.notes: Adds read-only Mingjian asset and vulnerability sync through the device tool registry.
changelog: Uses mingjian_vuln_scanner_assets for scanned asset ingestion.
Uses mingjian_vuln_scanner_results for vulnerability finding ingestion.
Keeps device targeting configurable through FLOCKS_CONNECTOR_DEVICE_ID.
